title.en: Tale 17 — The Owls and the Crows

sentences.ar: قال بيدبا: وهلق بدي أحكي عن العدو.
sentences.en: Bidpai said: and now I want to tell you about the enemy.

words.caphi_raw: h a l l a q||2

sentences.ar: لأنه اللي ما بيعرف عدوه بيموت.
sentences.en: Because whoever does not know his enemy dies.

sentences.ar: كان في جبل، وعلى الجبل شجرة كبيرة فيها ألف عش غراب.
sentences.en: There was a mountain, and on the mountain a big tree with a thousand crows' nests.

words.caphi_raw: sh a J a r a , s a j a r a

sentences.ar: وقريب منها مغارة، فيها ألف بومة.
sentences.en: And near it a cave, with a thousand owls.

words.caphi_raw: m a gh aa r a

sentences.en: And between the owls and the crows there was an old enmity.

words.caphi_raw: gh i r b aa n

sentences.ar: ما حدا بيتذكر من وين إجت.
sentences.en: No one remembered where it came from.

words.caphi_raw: y i t Z||D a K K a r

sentences.en: Owls see at night and crows by day.

words.caphi_raw: b i l l ee l
gh i r b aa n

sentences.ar: فكل واحد كان بيهجم لما التاني أعمى.
sentences.en: So each attacked when the other was blind.

words.caphi_raw: y u h J u m

sentences.en: One night, the owls attacked the tree.

words.caphi_raw: b a l ii l a
sh a J a r a , s a j a r a

sentences.ar: الغربان كانوا نايمين وما بيشوفوا، والبوم قتلوا منهم كتار.
sentences.en: The crows were asleep and could not see, and the owls killed many of them.

words.caphi_raw: gh i r b aa n

sentences.ar: لما طلعت الشمس، البوم رجعوا لمغارتهم.
sentences.en: When the sun rose, the owls returned to their cave.

words.caphi_raw: m a gh aa r a

sentences.en: And the crows sat on the ground weeping.

words.caphi_raw: gh i r b aa n

sentences.ar: ملك الغربان جمع الوزرا وقال: شو نعمل؟
sentences.en: The king of the crows gathered the ministers and said: what do we do?

words.caphi_raw: gh i r b aa n

sentences.en: One said: we flee to another mountain.

words.caphi_raw: h a r r i b

sentences.en: Another said: we attack them by day.

sentences.ar: قال تالت: نعطيهم الشجرة ونطلب الصلح.
sentences.en: A third said: we give them the tree and ask for peace.

words.caphi_raw: sh a J a r a , s a j a r a

sentences.en: And every opinion had a flaw.

sentences.ar: كان في غراب كبير بالعمر، وعاقل، وكان ساكت.
sentences.en: There was a crow old in years, and wise, and he was silent.
The king said: and you, what do you think?
The old crow said: if we flee, they follow us.

words.caphi_raw: h a r r i b

sentences.en: If we attack, they kill us.

words.caphi_raw: y i Q t u l

sentences.en: If we ask peace, they humiliate us.

sentences.ar: في طريق رابع، بس محدا رح يحبه.
sentences.en: There is a fourth way, but no one will like it.
The king said: speak.
He said: I must go in among them.

sentences.ar: وعشان يصدقوني، لازم تنتفوا ريشي وتضربوني.
sentences.en: And for them to believe me, you must pluck my feathers and beat me.

words.caphi_raw: y u s. d u q
t a n t i f

sentences.en: And then throw me under the tree.

words.caphi_raw: w u b a 3 d ee n
sh a J a r a , s a j a r a

sentences.en: The crows cried: impossible!

words.caphi_raw: gh i r b aa n
m u s t a 7 ii l

sentences.en: You are the eldest of us!

sentences.ar: قال الغراب الكبير: عشان هيك أنا.
sentences.en: The old crow said: that is why it is me.
A young one they would not believe.

words.caphi_raw: y u s. d u q

sentences.ar: وبعدين، لما تشوفوني مرمي، لا تبكوا.
sentences.en: And then, when you see me thrown down, do not weep.

words.caphi_raw: w u b a 3 d ee n

sentences.en: Go back to your nests and wait.
And so it was.
They plucked his feathers, beat him, and threw him down.

words.caphi_raw: n a t t i f

sentences.ar: وطاروا وتركوه على الأرض، وهم يبكوا بصمت.
sentences.en: And they flew away and left him on the ground, weeping in silence.

words.caphi_raw: y u b s. u m

sentences.en: And night came.
